name: La Flèche Wallonne
story: A six-rider early breakaway gained just over three minutes, but was kept under control by the favorites' teams. Former winners Alaphilippe and Hirschi both abandoned. Tobias Hallen Johannesen crashed, but could resume the race. On the final ascent of Mur de Huy, Seixas attacked decisively with only four riders able to respond, ultimately taking the win ahead of Schmid and Tullett.
